implemented: OS and CPU counters with lazy availability checks and frequency discovery
Suite, nested/imported attributes and CLI selection with explicit precedence
All Suite timing boundaries including async, allocations and shared worker starts
Empty-interval diagnostics and minimum black-box-loop interval over 100 batches of 10000 iterations
Per-clock diagnostic cache, run provenance, raw observations and cold/test/custom exclusions
Bounded delayed resolution probing after zero-only immediate intervals: 32 trials per power-of-two delay from 1 through 1024; at most 608 resolution trials total

Optional Suite/CLI compensation emits wall.adjusted alongside raw wall; combines fractional loop/tally costs, clamps each interval, takes each wave maximum before summing waves, and retains checked adjusted worker records
Compensation attributes on cases, nested/imported groups and suites; explicit raw settings override defaults and CLI overrides all selected cases

measurement_policy.loop_ratio: loop_batch_ns / loop_iterations; retain the integer numerator and denominator to represent sub-nanosecond costs
measurement_policy.empty_interval: Minimum including zero from 256 immediate trials only; delayed intervals never inflate empty-read cost
measurement_policy.cache: once per process and real clock, before workload callbacks; no sample/warmup budget consumption
measurement_policy.exclusions: No diagnostic calibration for cold runs, test mode, caller-only timings, list or dry-run
measurement_policy.raw: Raw wall always preserved. Opt-in compensation writes wall.adjusted; caller-timed, cold and smoke cases remain raw. Scheduling, quick stopping and workload budgets use raw intervals.
measurement_policy.resolution: Smallest nonzero observation at first successful delay; explicit unresolved status after exhausting retries; measured estimate, not a guaranteed hardware quantum

limitations: x86 runtime evidence is Rosetta on Apple Silicon, not a physical x86 host. Native OS/architecture coverage remains in the separate platforms requirement.
Compensation estimates uncontended bookkeeping, not workload-specific cache behavior or shared atomic contention.

runtime_evidence.arm64: Native aarch64-apple-darwin: library and integration suites, plus bracketed frequency test passed
runtime_evidence.x86_64: x86_64-apple-darwin Mach-O binaries run via Rosetta: 65 library tests and 3 timer integration tests passed, then the additional bracketed frequency test passed
